### Kroger Ushers in Fall with New Limited-Time Private Selection™ Pumpkin Harvest Collection


September 16, 2026


*The all-new collection features* *15+ pumpkin-inspired products to enjoy all day long.*


CINCINNATI


, Sept. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's grocer, is welcoming fall with the launch of its limited-time Private Selection™ Pumpkin Harvest Collection, a seasonal lineup crafted to bring all the comforting flavors of autumn to every part of the day. The collection will be exclusively available across the Kroger Co. Family of Stores.*


"That first crisp morning is the best sign that fall has officially arrived, welcoming in the warm flavors and spices that make this season so special," said Ann Reed, Group Vice President of Our Brands at Kroger. "Our new Private Selection Pumpkin Harvest Collection was crafted to help customers embrace the season with flavors that make every coffee break, afternoon snack and sweet seasonal treat even more memorable."


The collection offers new ways to enjoy pumpkin across beverages, snacks, bakery favorites and more.


**Pumpkin in Every Pour**


Every fall beverage is better with these pumpkin-flavored sips that bring a taste of the season to life:


- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Gourmet Ground Coffee and Coffee Pods:** Smooth coffee infused with pumpkin, cinnamon and nutmeg
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Syrup:** A blend of cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and clove flavors that adds a seasonal twist to any favorite beverage
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Flavored Chai Black Tea:** Black tea blended with pumpkin flavor and warming spices for a satisfying seasonal sip


**Cozy Crunches**


Snack your way through the season with these sweet, salty and satisfyingly crunchy bites:


- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Popcorn:** Crunchy popcorn glazed with pumpkin spice and finished with a sweet icing drizzle
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Cashews:** Kettle-cooked cashews coated in sugar and aromatic allspice
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Cheesecake Granola Clusters:** Crunchy, snackable granola clusters inspired by the rich flavors of pumpkin cheesecake


**Sweeten the Season**


Indulge in the sweeter side of autumn with these freshly baked pumpkin treats:


- **Private Selection** ™ **Gluten-Free Pumpkin Streusel Muffins:** Soft muffins crafted with real pumpkin and seasonal spices, topped with streusel and sparkling sugar – and even better warmed up
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Blondies:** Rich pumpkin blondie bites finished with cream cheese icing, pecans and butterscotch chips
- **Private Selection** ™ **Pumpkin Spice Shortbread Cookies:** Buttery shortbread with warm pumpkin spice for a crisp, melt-in-your-mouth bite


**Fall Is Bigger Than Just Pumpkin**


The Pumpkin Harvest lineup is just the beginning of fall at Kroger. As game-day season kicks off, customers can build a winning spread with[Private Selection™ All Beef Hot Dogs](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=1833976991&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kroger.com%2Fp%2Fprivate-selection-all-beef-hot-dogs%2F0001111000637&a=Private+Selection%E2%84%A2+All+Beef+Hot+Dogs) and[Private Selection™ Applewood Smoked Bacon & Cheddar Angus Beef Patties](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=2782336547&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kroger.com%2Fp%2Fprivate-selection-applewood-smoked-bacon-cheddar-angus-beef-patties%2F0001111097170%3Ffulfillment%3DDELIVERY%26searchType%3Ddefault_search&a=Private+Selection%E2%84%A2+Applewood+Smoked+Bacon+%26+Cheddar+Angus+Beef+Patties) , as well as guacamole made with[Kroger Brand Fresh Hass Avocados](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=2493907133&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kroger.com%2Fp%2Fkroger-fresh-hass-avocados-bag%2F0001111018180%3Ffulfillment%3DPICKUP&a=Kroger+Brand+Fresh+Hass+Avocados) and[Kroger Brand Guacamole Seasoning Mix](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=1357456116&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kroger.com%2Fp%2Fkroger-guacamole-seasoning-mix%2F0001111073981&a=Kroger+Brand+Guacamole+Seasoning+Mix) .


No matter how customers shop, Kroger makes it easy. Customers can get these deals and more in store or[Kroger.com](http://kroger.com/) offering the same fresh items at the same low prices for pickup at a convenient store location or delivery in as little as 30 minutes. For even more convenience, Kroger's full product assortment is available on demand at DoorDash and Uber Eats marketplaces, shopped from local stores and delivered directly to customers' doors.


* *Available across all Kroger Family of Stores locations excluding Food 4 Less.*


**About Kroger**


At The[Kroger](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=4250768060&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kroger.com%2F&a=Kroger) Co. (NYSE: KR), we are dedicated to our Purpose: To Feed the Human Spirit™. We are, across our family of companies, more than 400,000 associates who serve over 11 million customers daily through an eCommerce experience and retail food stores under a variety of[banner names](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=539924094&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thekrogerco.com%2Fabout%2Four-business%2F&a=banner+names) , serving America through food inspiration and uplift, and creating #ZeroHungerZeroWaste communities. To learn more about us, visit our[newsroom](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=4109761229&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.thekrogerco.com%2Fir-news&a=newsroom) and[investor relations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4772812-1&h=4213150114&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.kroger.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investor+relations) site.
